column1: # The nightly guard over the NULL-mode kernels' deoptimization cycle (VARKA-378), read by
# dev/varka_deopt_census.sh --guard and dev/varka_deopt_census.py --guard. One row per width:
# pref is the preferred species (512 bits on the laptop), 16 is -XX:MaxVectorSize=16 (128 bits).
# Each row is one JVM over draws [from, from + draws) of both lanes, at the seed, under the matrix
# base options, with the warm-up's deadline in ms, pinned to cpus cores from cpu_base.
# The ratchet is the most kernels past the deadline with more than four profile_predicate traps
# the width may count: the step fails above it. The count moves with the machine's load (the
# cycle's traps come slower on a busy machine, so more kernels are caught at the deadline), so
# lower it when two nightly runs count fewer, and say why in the commit; it only ever falls, and
# rises only with a plan that measured why. Set from three runs on a loaded laptop: pref 8, 8, 2
